POST /sprints still 403 (manager+ role). Owner regression 200 on task create + time entry + timer start/stop + delete. The 2 intentional failures in tests/test_iter8_scoping.py were re-pointed at the new intended behaviour (time-entry 403, member task create 200) and now pass. rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of the iteration-8 gap: create_time_entry and start_timer authorized only with ensure_member(org_id, user_id) and never resolved body.task_id -> project, so a member with 0 project memberships could log time / start a timer on any task in the org. Fix verified: both routes now `await require_task_access(org_id, task_id, user)` which 404s an unknown task and 403s a task whose project the caller is not a member of (owners/admins bypass). The Tasks.jsx canCreate role guard was replaced by `projects.length > 0`, which matches the backend rule (project access, not role) — confirmed in the UI for both the attached (button present, create works) and detached (button absent) states.
